messages.subject: splittings
parts:
Another thought on why it might be nice to be able to break models
into an arbitrary number of subblocks: we might be able to use this as
a way to tell Stan how to implement symplectic integration strategies
based on splitting the Hamiltonian. Not sure how much use that feature
would get, but it'd be fun to play with.

(The recent discussion with Chad Scherrer brought this to mind.)

Matt
